storyCards.headline: Hey Mama: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
David Guetta's "Hey Mama" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hey Mama" is a song recorded by the French DJ and record producer David Guetta featuring singers Nicki Minaj and Bebe Rexha, and co-production by the Dutch record producer Afrojack.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Hey Mama was released in 2014.

Artist: David Guetta · Title: Hey Mama · Album: David Guetta Feat.

Chart story — peaked at #8 on the Hot 100.
